about: Public figures for the models in Arity's default providers, the starting values of the leaderboard (core/src/leaderboard.rs). quality is the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (0-100) where one was found; ttft_ms is time to first token in milliseconds; tps is output tokens per second. A figure that was not found is left out, never guessed. Each entry says where its figures came from and when they were read. A live fetcher can later replace this file with the same shape.

sources.quality: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, as cited by https://kie.ai/blog/what-is-gpt-6-2-sol (no Artificial Analysis page was found directly)

sources.ttft_ms: Artificial Analysis, time to first answer token at high effort (includes reasoning), https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/gpt-6-1-terra-high

sources.quality: Intelligence Index as listed on OpenRouter, https://openrouter.ai/compare/nousresearch/hermes-4-70b/nousresearch/hermes-4-405b
